checks.name: Preview does not reserve a time or leak event metadata, even on repeat
A visit changed while the provider answers cannot exclude its now-stale reservation
Reordered same-range Calendar response cannot replace a newer busy projection with older free time
Preview shares the durable provider budget and exhaustion never returns free openings
Manual own-visit preview excludes only its current booking and keeps another saved reservation full
Preview cannot turn foreign ownership, source/config change or revoked authorization into a valid result
Failed preview and attempted caller exclusions cannot fabricate a free empty schedule
